description: The full check on a Robinhood Chain token in one call: the safety check (can you sell it, taxes, owner), price and pool depth, who holds it and which holders are linked, whether the launch was bundled, and what the dev did. Returns one verdict (high, caution or low) with the reasons behind it, each tagged with its section, plus a one-line summary per section. Use this first for 'is this token safe?', 'should I worry about this token?', 'check this token'. Use token_holders, bundle_check or dev_check for more detail on one part. Robinhood Chain only for now.

token.description: Token contract address (0x...) on Robinhood Chain

title: Token report (safety, holders, launch, dev)
